subject_need: Prevent acceptable aggregate calibration from hiding decision errors that cross severe loss boundaries.
alternative_solutions: Keep only unweighted Brier score and rely on manual reviewer interpretation.
Add free-text severity comments without executable threshold or classification rules.
Create a separate consequence package rather than extending the existing calibration-report package.
non_solution_options: Treat larger samples, more segments, or lower aggregate scores as quality.
defer_options: Defer consequence modeling until production data exists, leaving the structural contract undefined.
stop_options: Stop if consequence weights are presented as money, objective harm magnitude, automatic authority, or cross-domain truth.
Stop if false-assurance and false-alarm classifications cannot be deterministically reproduced from reviewed inputs.
